title: Inventory European ROM reads after indexed archive use
changes: Record a bounded source-read inventory after the guarded indexed-archive continuation and identify remaining addresses that require reader attribution before proposing another resource.
validation: Wine unit e170-post-indexed-raw-audit-wine-108ejhdv observes 12 recorded neutral frames using the authenticated E170 dataset and retained guarded translation. Instrumented and reference states, clocks, video, OAM, dispatch and audio match each frame; protected inputs passed and Wine drained.

Read-only reconciliation e170-post-indexed-reconcile-c8paxoub verifies earlier source witnesses against the exact EUR ROM. Of 4,680 bytes outside manifest spans, 3,600 are within the previously documented copied-IWRAM block and 12 match hardware/branch support. Of 1,068 lower-ROM bytes, 500 overlap previous source witnesses and 568 do not.
limitations: The observed copied block contains executable support but individual bytes are not all classified as instructions. Earlier witnesses do not establish the current reader PCs; the 568 unmatched bytes are leads rather than established assets. Byte reads at 14d2dc..14d2ec need reader and extent attribution.
The audit covers one short recorded window and selected instrumented readers. Other scenes and consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
